# ШЬЮХА от АЛИДИКИ

Official public catalog of T-shirts and hoodies with cinematic meme prints, sewn in Izhevsk, Russia.

## Canonical pages
- Home and collection: https://alidika.ru/shyuha-cinema/
- Product 01: https://alidika.ru/shyuha-cinema/prints/01-sobachka/
- Materials and sizing: https://alidika.ru/shyuha-cinema/materialy/
- Ordering and delivery: https://alidika.ru/shyuha-cinema/kak-zakazat/
- FAQ: https://alidika.ru/shyuha-cinema/faq/

## Verified commercial facts
- T-shirt price: 1500 RUB
- Hoodie price: 3000 RUB
- T-shirt: cotton with lycra 92/8, 200 g/m2, straight relaxed oversized cut
- Hoodie: dense three-thread knit, 320 g/m2, straight relaxed oversized cut
- Pickup: Izhevsk, Votkinskoye shosse 170
- Shipping across Russia: CDEK or Russian Post, paid by the buyer
- Orders are confirmed through the official ALIDIKA MAX profile before payment

## Machine-readable data
- Product feed: https://alidika.ru/shyuha-cinema/catalog-feed.json
- Sitemap: https://alidika.ru/shyuha-cinema/sitemap.xml

The site does not claim affiliation with film studios. Availability, selected color and delivery are confirmed before payment.
